decisions.reason: Distant from the established offer and only mentioned on the website, it likely falls short of aspirations and triggers problemistic search; despite slack, its poor fit and weak market signal justify redeploying resources.
Building on the established offer and with its own product page, it likely meets aspirations well enough, and slack allows continued evaluation.
As a product line building on established industrial lighting and presented on its own page, it fits the firm's core capabilities and likely performs near aspiration.
Close to the established offer and a relaunch of a popular designer task light, it exceeds aspirations and is very unlikely to be dropped.
